ladder.label: COUNTER-TREND BOUNCE
ladder.why: Short-term, a daily bottoming setup is forming — but the bigger picture is bearish (weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue). A bounce here is COUNTER-TREND: daily-cycle lows that don't line up with a weekly-cycle low tend to be left-translated and fail, then cascade toward the larger cycle low — exactly the trap of buying a daily low in a falling investor cycle.
ladder.next: Nimble traders only — small size, tight stop below 11.21. Not an investment buy; wait for the weekly timeframe to actually turn up (or a fresh investor-cycle low to confirm) before trusting it.
ladder.regime_why: weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BEARISH — weekly momentum positive; but rolling toward a weekly cross-down; 3-day crossed down; investor cycle overdue (investor cycle week 46 · daily cycle day 45).
